Quest description. Not shown by Quest001.bla; this copy says Nemos, while the shipped QuestMess entry (0.52) says GM IIs and the event portraits are GM II. Translated as written (Nemo, per glossary Nemo A/B).
Speaker GM II (CHARA_NAME 214), both brawling GM IIs on screen; 0.18 the same.
Script shows only TextIdOffset+18 (row 0.19) with the party leader as speaker; 0.20-0.33 are unused identical variants.

Leader-variant blocks (0.35-0.49, 0.52-0.66, 0.69-0.83, 0.85-0.99) are indexed by the Pt_Chara_Check order in Quest001.bla: Zeta, Nu, Zero, W (Shotaro), OOO, Mebius, Den-O Sword (Momotaros), 00, Wing Zero, Black RX, Rider 1, Ultraman, Seven, God Gundam, Taro. Confirmed by the polite rows landing on OOO/Mebius and the rough ones on Zero/Momotaros.
Not referenced by Quest001.bla (unused). Rough wording and Ankh (CHARA 36) being in the scene suggest an Ankh line agreeing to step in; voiced as Ankh. Uncertain.
Speaker GM II (slot 1), coming to after the fight.
GM II (slot 1); 0.68 is the second GM II (slot 3); 0.84 GM II slot 1.

report: All 80 rows examined. Slice had no speaker labels; speakers and leader-variant order recovered from Quest001.bla. Row 0.50 is unused in the script, speaker inferred as Ankh. Row 0.5 says Nemo while QuestMess says GM II; kept as written.
